item.title: 🕹️ GTA VI PC Port Takes Shape An open-source GitHub project is rebuilding the X…
item.description: 🕹️ GTA VI PC Port Takes Shape An open-source GitHub project is rebuilding the Xbox version of GTA VI for Windows. It has already become the platform’s most popular open-source project. The released files include models, textures, audio, and all 26,500 shaders translated for PC. The main missing piece is the.exe file, which CyberLeek is offering in exchange for a crypto scam, though it may later be published anyway. ✔️ Xbox version rebuilt for Windows ✔️ Models, textures, and audio extracted ✔️ 26,500 shaders translated for PC ✔️ The executable is still missing 👉 Github 👈 The port is not complete yet, while Rockstar could still disrupt the effort with an official PC release. 💻 @program

item.description: 📱 Android Apps On iPhone Andarium can now run APK files on an iPhone by launching a virtual Android 17 environment. This makes it possible to try apps that are unavailable in the App Store, including some banking apps, depending on compatibility. ✔️ Virtual Android 17 runs directly on iPhone ✔️ Internet, camera, and microphone access are available ✔️ VPN must be disabled for Andarium to work properly 👉 Link 👈 App support depends on each APK, so compatibility may vary. 💻 @program
